label: Efficient total giving of participated esse preserves each admitted pure determination in the giver
paraphrase: Open analyst premise, confined to giving esse to actual participants. For each pure determination in a selected inventory, if the recipient really has it, so does each efficient total giver of its esse. Has expresses the same real content in both bearers. It requires no identity of their act-tokens or modes. An application admitting eminent realization must identify that content in the source. Productive power and the aggregate degree of either bearer do not occur in the test.
